Dubai and Sharjah private schools

KHDA required Dubai private schools to follow the unified calendar, so the October break moved to 12–16 October. Sharjah private schools have their own calendar: winter break 14 December – 3 January, spring break 5–8 April and the year ending on 1 July.

The year has 185 school days in three terms, and the last week of each term is for final assessments with attendance required. Public holidays are on UAE public holidays.

Frequently asked questions

When is the winter break 2026 in the UAE?

From Monday 14 December 2026 for students, with return on Monday 4 January 2027, under the ministry's unified calendar; staff start their break on 21 December.

When is the spring break 2027?

From 5 to 11 April 2027 including the weekend, back on 12 April; Sharjah private schools break on 5–8 April.

When does the 2026–2027 school year end?

The last day for students is Friday 2 July 2027 in MOE and Dubai schools and Thursday 1 July in Sharjah private schools; the next year starts on 30 August 2027.
